entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I always think about Wakaba on the[n]anniversary of her death... but[n]it's been a while since I visited.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I've been so busy with the shop and all...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: No, that's not it... The guilt is[n]what kept me from coming. I thought[n]Wakaba would be angry with me...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: But now that I managed to get[n]Futaba over here, I can finally[n]meet her with my head held high.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I sure kept her waiting... but it[n]felt good to tell her about how[n]much Futaba's improved lately.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Oh... I told her about you too.
Good for you.
Thank you.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: You say that like you're not[n]responsible for all this.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Sorry about that.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Idiot. I should be the one thanking you.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Huh... This is the first time[n]the four of us are all together.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Sojiro? What are you smirking for?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Er...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: This is what my real smile looks like.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I approve.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Phew...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Oh, I have some news.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: The family court gave me a call[n]the other day. Futaba's uncle[n]decided to retract his report.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: It was 'cause of you, wasn't it?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: It's like he had one of those[n]"change of heart" things I[n]keep hearing about...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...Nah, that couldn't be.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: *sigh* I wonder if the day'll come that[n]she goes out to be someone's bride.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I'm sure she'll make a fine lady either way.[n]After all... she is Wakaba's daughter.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: *sigh* Do all fathers have to[n]go through this anxiety...?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: You know, I really just wanted to[n]have you help out at the store.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: But you showed me so much[n]more... You showed me I have[n]a family I need to protect.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Not just Futaba...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: But you too.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I may not always be reliable, but feel[n]free to come to me if anything happens.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I'll be there for you... as family.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: And... Ah, I know.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I'll teach you everything I can.[n]You're a full-fledged man now.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: That might not be enough to return[n]the favor... but it's all I can do.
I feel a strong bond with Sojiro...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Oh, and uh... could you not...[n]you know, get with Futaba?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I can't imagine you calling me "father"...[n]Although, maybe it wouldn't be so bad...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: What are you two talking about?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Nothing!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I hunger! Curry time!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Yeah, yeah...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Let's go home.
